about: Open, filed installer bugs the journeys hit. Each entry matches one row's phase by an exact output signature (kind 'failure': the phase's output; kind 'finding': the finding's text) and shows as 'known #issue' instead of failing the row. A row fails again when its entry stops matching, so remove the entry in the PR that fixes the bug. Add one only for a filed issue. 'blocks': the phases after it cannot run, so they are skipped rather than failed.
